chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:
I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'Does a man marry the woman who accepted him (as her husband)?' He said: 'Glory be to Allah, what did Allah forbid him from that?'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (peace be upon him), the eighth Imam

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to marry a woman who accepted him as her spouse?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the ruling on a man marrying a woman who has accepted him, responding with 'Subhanallah' to indicate that Allah has not prohibited this union. This concise response underscores the principle of permissibility (*al-asl fi al-ashya' al-ibahah*) in marital contracts unless specific textual evidence dictates otherwise, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence. The context of Chapter 115, dealing with the marriage of the midwife (*al-qabula*), highlights the practical application of these rules in familial and social relationships.
